title: GitHub Actions or Jenkins: Choosing a CI/CD Platform
excerpt: GitHub Actions is built into GitHub; Jenkins is the long-standing self-hosted automation server. The comparison covers setup effort, flexibility and cost.
verdict: For most modern projects hosted on GitHub, Actions is faster to adopt and simpler to maintain. Jenkins remains the stronger choice when you need complete control and customisation, or your code does not live on GitHub.

spec1.label: Setup
spec1.device1Value: Built into GitHub and quick to start
spec1.device2Value: Needs its own server to install and maintain

spec2.label: Flexibility and customisation
spec2.device1Value: Good, but tied to the GitHub platform
spec2.device2Value: Almost unlimited, with a very large plugin ecosystem

spec3.label: Cost for a small open-source project
spec3.device2Value: Free software, but you pay for and run the hosting
